name: RFB CNPJ — Empresas (legal entities) bulk ZIP
note: Empresas split Empresas0..9.zip; also Estabelecimentos0..9, Socios0..9, Simples, and reference tables (Cnaes/Naturezas/Municipios/Paises/Qualificacoes/Motivos). Latin-1-compatible source, ;-delimited, NO header; Dagster normalizes extracted RFB CSVs to UTF-8 for DuckDB. Replace {YYYY-MM-DD} with the latest dated snapshot folder for the desired month, e.g. 2026-05-10. The mirror is headlessly fetchable; Receita Federal remains the authoritative source owner.

name: CVM DFP — listed-company annual financial statements (per year)
note: Per-year ZIP with index + BPA/BPP/DRE/DFC/DMPL/DRA/DVA (_con/_ind) + capital + parecer. Keyed on CNPJ_CIA + CD_CVM. Latin-1, ;-delimited, header row. Currency BRL, scale MIL. No key.

name: CVM ITR — listed-company quarterly statements (per year)
note: Quarterly equivalent of DFP. Same schema. No key.
